A '''laboratory''' was used by [[Project Protean]] on a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] in the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]]. Though tightly guarded, around [[3640 BBY]] it was infiltrated by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]], who was searching for the reason Protean was targeting him and his safe houses.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The laboratory is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Eckard Lokin's companion storyline.<ref name="SWTOR" />
